steps: Open the app in the dark colour scheme (browser context colorScheme: 'dark')
Section 1.2 -> Print a test
page.emulateMedia({ media: 'print' }) and read the computed style of the test panel (main > div)
page.pdf({ format: 'Letter', printBackground: true }) in the dark scheme, then render every PDF page and sample its pixels
expected: Black on white in print media and in the PDF, whatever the screen theme.
actual: In print media under the dark scheme the panel computes background rgb(255,255,255) and colour rgb(0,0,0) (body the same; screen media still shows rgb(27,36,41)/rgb(228,233,230) as it should). The 5-page PDF produced in the dark scheme is 90-95% pure white per page with dark text and is byte-for-byte the same rendering as the PDF produced with colorScheme 'light' (top colours per page identical). Also checked with emulateMedia({ media:'print', colorScheme:'dark' }) explicitly: still white.

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=12.6&count=20&seed=1 and read key entry 8
Open #/print?scope=section&id=1.3&count=20&seed=42 and read key entry 10
Open #/print?scope=section&id=11.3&count=20&seed=42 and read key entry 12 (part h)
Open #/print?scope=chapter&id=3&count=15&seed=755886 key 5, and #/print?scope=section&id=1.4&count=20&seed=3 / #/print?scope=practice-test&id=1&count=50&seed=9 for the cases that are now clean
expected: No literal [PARTS]/[TABLE]/[DATA]/[LIST] or pipe-delimited rows anywhere in the key.
actual: Partly fixed, not gone. The plain cases now render properly: 1.4 (any seed), Practice Test 1 (seeds 1 and 9, 55 and 50 questions), 2.1 seed 42 and all 3 practice tests and both finals are clean, multi-part answers come out as real a./b./c. lists, simple tables as real tables, and no pipe-delimited rows survive anywhere. But literal tags still print whenever a part contains a table or a nested list: '[PARTS]...[/PARTS]' wraps key 8 of 12.6 seed 1 (also 7/seed 7, 13/seed 42), key 10 of 1.3 seed 42, key 5 of chapter 3 seed 755886, key 11 of chapter 1 count 20 seed 7; and the nested case round one flagged is unchanged - 11.3 seed 42 key 12 part h still reads '[PARTS] i. Alpha: 0.05 ii. Decision: ...'. In a sweep of 66 printed tests (chapters 1/3/7/11/12 at 10/15/20/30 x seeds 7/11/2024 plus six section tests) 35 had at least one key entry containing literal tags. The same tags now also appear on the question side (filed separately as print-question-raw-markup).

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=1.2&count=0&seed=1 ('Too small: expected number to be >=1')
Change only the hash to #/print?scope=section&id=1.2&count=10&seed=1 (no reload)
Then hash-navigate bad again (count=500), then to #/print?scope=section&id=1.3&count=15&seed=2, then chapter and final URLs in a row
expected: Each valid URL renders its test.
actual: Every bad->good hash navigation now renders: count=0 -> count=10 gives 10 questions and a key; count=500 -> 1.3 count=15 gives 15; a chain of error -> section -> chapter -> final rendered 10, 15 and 23 questions respectively with the right headers. No stale error survived a hash change in any of the attempts.

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=1.4&count=20&seed=3 in print media and look at question 3 (parts a-f)
Also questions 5, 6, 10 of the same test and question 1 (parts a-l) and 15 (parts a-g) of #/print?scope=section&id=1.3&count=20&seed=42
expected: Each lettered part gets its own writing space, or the box is sized for the number of parts.
actual: Still one dashed box for the whole question, placed after the last part; no part has a box of its own (0 of 6 parts in 1.4 Q3, 0 of 12 in 1.3 Q1). The box is now 160px tall instead of round one's ~80px, so it is twice the space, but it does not grow with the number of parts: a 2-part question and a 12-part question both get exactly one 160px box, and parts a-e have no room beside them.

steps: Section 1.2 -> Print a test
Click 'New test (different questions)' three times
Press Back three times, then once more, then Forward
expected: Back steps through each earlier test, then to the section page.
actual: The four tests have four distinct URLs (seeds 258598, 641776, 20395, 938694) and four distinct first questions. Back #1, #2 and #3 landed on seeds 20395, 641776 and 258598 in turn - URL match, 10 questions each, and the same first question as when that test was first shown. A fourth Back reached #/section/1.2, and Forward returned to the first test with its questions intact.

steps: Open the home page and look under 'Whole-book paper tests:'
Click 'Print OpenStax Final Exam 1' and 'Print OpenStax Final Exam 2'
expected: A page offers the final exams and the printed page says how long the exam is.
actual: The home page now has a 'Whole-book paper tests:' block with 'Print OpenStax Final Exam 1' (#/print?scope=final&id=1&count=100&seed=1) and 'Print OpenStax Final Exam 2'. Both render: exam 1 is headed 'Introductory Statistics · 31 questions · test code final:1:1' and exam 2 '· 23 questions ·', so the real length is stated even though the link asks for 100.

steps: Open #/print?scope=chapter&id=3&count=15&seed=755886 question 7
Open #/print?scope=chapter&id=2&count=30&seed=5 question 1
Open #/print?scope=chapter&id=1&count=30&seed=5 questions 7, 11, 28
expected: Questions start with a readable stem.
actual: Unchanged. Chapter 3 Q7 still opens with the bare URL 'http://www.esa.doc.gov/sites/default/files/womeninstemagaptoinnovation8311.pdf' and contains '&mathematics)'; chapter 2 Q1 still has no stem and starts at 'a. For runners in a race...'; chapter 1 Q7/Q11/Q28 still start lowercase with 'the table below contains...'. Noted only; content is audited separately.

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=11.3&count=20&seed=42
Read key entries 2, 3, 7, 8 and 10
actual: Unchanged. Key 8's total still reads '10,0450' for 100,450; key 10 still runs 'the year.df = 12' together; keys 2, 3 and 7 still print the answer twice ('0.0435 / 0.0435', '6.6 / 6.6', '10301.8 / 10,301.8' - the second line differs only in thousands separators). Noted only; content is audited separately.

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=1.3&count=20&seed=42 and look at answer-key entry 10 ('# Flossing per Week')
Save it as a PDF (page.pdf, Letter) and look at the key page
Compare with key entry 8 of #/print?scope=section&id=11.3&count=20&seed=42, which renders correctly
Also #/print?scope=section&id=12.6&count=20&seed=1 key 8, #/print?scope=chapter&id=3&count=15&seed=755886 key 5, and question 56 of #/print?scope=chapter&id=2&count=100&seed=1
expected: A table in an answer (or in a question) prints as a table: a header row and one row per data row, fitting the page width like every other table does.
actual: Tables that sit inside a multi-part answer are flattened into a single row: 1.3 key 10 is one row of 19 cells, 12.6 key 8 one row of 11 cells, chapter 3 key 5 one row of 21 cells, and the three frequency tables in chapter 2 question 56 are one row of 7 cells each. Header labels and data are jammed into the same row ('cents/oz 16 | 3.99 | 24.94 32 | 4.99 | ...'), so the answer cannot be read. The flattened row is wider than the page - 1302px inside a 768px panel for 1.3 key 10 - so the printed PDF cuts it off mid-cell at the right margin (page 6 of the Letter PDF), and on screen at 1000px the print page itself scrolls sideways (document scrollWidth 1478 vs window 1000), in print media too. A table that is not inside a multi-part answer (11.3 key 8) still renders correctly as 6 rows x 7 cells and fits.

steps: Open #/section/1.4
Set the 'worked problems' dropdown to 'none' (leave questions at 10)
Click 'Print a test'
expected: A printable test appears - shorter than asked if need be - or the page explains that section 1.4 has no questions left once worked problems are excluded.
actual: The page goes to #/print?scope=section&id=1.4&count=10&seed=...&templateShare=0&openShare=0 and shows only 'no questions available for this scope'. No test, no key, no explanation that it is the 'worked problems: none' choice that emptied it, and nothing in the page body to click back with - the learner has to use the site nav or the Back button. Same for count=5 and count=20 on 1.4. The setting works elsewhere (1.1 gives 8 questions, 1.2 gives 10, chapter 1 gives 22), so it is only this combination that dead-ends, and the message blames the 'scope'.

steps: Open #/print?scope=chapter&id=2&count=100&seed=1 and look at question 56
Open #/print?scope=chapter&id=3&count=30&seed=7 question 24, #/print?scope=chapter&id=7&count=100&seed=1 question 77, and #/print?scope=chapter&id=8&count=100&seed=1 questions 8, 22 and 87
expected: Questions never show markup; sub-parts print as a./b./c. and definitions as a list.
actual: Literal tags now appear in the questions a learner answers, not just in the key: chapter 2 Q56 prints '[PARTS]' before its three frequency tables, chapter 3 Q24 prints '[LIST] G = card drawn is green E = card drawn is even-numbered ... [/LIST]', chapter 7 Q77 prints a nested '[PARTS] i. x̄ = _____ ii. sx = _____ iii. n = _____', and chapter 8 Q8, Q22 and Q87 the same. Round one saw these tags only in the answer key.

steps: Open #/print?scope=section&id=1.2&count=2.5&seed=1
Also count=abc, seed=abc, count=0, count=500, seed=-1, scope=bogus, scope=review&id=1, scope=chapter&id=14
expected: If a printed test cannot be made, say which setting is wrong in words a learner understands and offer a way on.
actual: The print page prints the raw validator text as the whole page: 'Invalid input: expected int, received number' (count=2.5), 'Invalid input: expected number, received NaN' (count=abc or seed=abc), 'Too small: expected number to be >=1' (count=0), 'Too big: expected number to be <=100' (count=500), 'Too small: expected number to be >=0' (seed=-1), 'Invalid option: expected one of "section"|"chapter"|"practice-test"|"final"|"review"' (scope=bogus), 'no questions available for this scope' (chapter 14, final 3, practice-test 99, scope=review&id=1), 'No test specified.' (no id). None of them names the setting at fault and none offers a link back to the section or chapter; the page body holds no controls at all.
